svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.nitrogen-cycle-reservoir-model", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced six-reservoir terrestrial nitrogen-matter pathway graph, distinguishing fixation, two-step nitrification, denitrification, selected plant assimilation and return by ammonification. Six learned reservoir frames and seven processes form one introduced relationship. Selected matter pathways, not an energy cycle or a global measured nitrogen budget. Fixation entry and denitrification are aggregate processes, not single elementary reactions. Ammonium and ammonia are not silently identical chemical species: the selected pool entry includes the environmental ammonia/ammonium step. Nitrate assimilation is one selected plant route; ammonium uptake, animal feeding, fertilisers, leaching, atmospheric deposition, marine pathways and other microbial alternatives are outside this sparse model, not denied. Shape/position role learning and physical readability remain untested.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Reservoir-frame corners and arrowhead tips retained as logical anchors. Continuous Swell/ViewPlus paths shared; no Braille or touch-recognition result.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "arrow_repair": {"source": "BANA2022section3.4.3.7", "construction": "Open equilateral heads,8mm sides/base throughout this diagram;9mm shaft-to-apex separation. Local size exception retains3mmcomponent clearances where12mmheads do not. Nominal design only.", "old_master": "tactile/masters/education/science/ecology/nitrogen-cycle-reservoir-model.svg", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}, "rejected_candidate": "tactile/masters/education/science/ecology/nitrogen-cycle-reservoir-model-v02.svg"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard, logical junctions de-duplicated. Optional near-junction samples may be omitted; node frames and directed head anchors retained. Not Braille or actual tactile recognition.
